mapper.insert: insert into `contest_signup`(contest_id, student_id, status, apply_time, audit_teacher_id, audit_teacher_name, audit_time, remark) values (#{contestId}, #{studentId}, #{status}, #{applyTime}, #{auditTeacherId}, #{auditTeacherName}, #{auditTime}, #{remark})
mapper.update: update `contest_signup` set contest_id = #{contestId}, student_id = #{studentId}, status = #{status}, apply_time = #{applyTime}, audit_teacher_id = #{auditTeacherId}, audit_teacher_name = #{auditTeacherName}, audit_time = #{auditTime}, remark = #{remark} where id = #{id}
